_unblocks_when: All seven successor blob ids are resolved to real 40-character lowercase git object ids recomputed from constructed execution bytes, AND authority.effective_at is replaced with the actual decision time (which changes planned_end and therefore the authorized successor digest, so successor.authorized_schedule_digest_rfc8785_sha256 must be recomputed at that point).
_verification_time_policy: The prior draft reproduced 2026-07-27T00:00:00+07:00 as example verification guidance. That is WITHDRAWN as backdating. verification_time is caller-supplied and no wall clock is read, so a stale or convenient value is undetectable from a receipt alone. Any verification of THIS proposal MUST supply the actual wall-clock instant of the verification event, in the register's +07:00 offset, and the receipt MUST record that instant together with a justification of why it is the true event time. Reusing the 2026-07-27 value is a stop condition.
